name: Nine Lives Stealer

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +2 sword; while it has charges, a Critical Hit on a creature with fewer than 100 Hit Points may tear out its soul (Con DC 15).
text: This weapon grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls and starts with 1d8 + 1 charges. Whenever you land a Critical Hit on a creature whose Hit Points are below 100, the target must make a Constitution saving throw against DC 15; on a failure the weapon rips the life force from its body and it dies on the spot. Constructs and Undead are immune. Each such kill spends 1 charge, and once no charges remain the weapon loses this killing power.
